title: Remove the generic-parameter premise for all-order Stein-rank bounds at exact fine-prime narrow-core widths
short_pr_body:
## Result
Remove genericity for exact fine-prime binary narrow cores: every order and inverse has rank at least min(2 ceil((N+3)/5),s_min-1), using bounded-degree CRT separation.

## Checks
`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fine-prime-binary-core-rank`
Independent review and negative controls passed. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Exact predecessor pins are linked below.

## Limits and credit
No new kappa; all five full assumptions remain. Both shift and chirp are removed; physical/rounded rank, minor magnitude and full costs remain open. Prepared for @CubeJerry; credit to cited predecessors and substantial OpenAI assistance.
